overview.description: The Columbia High Dividend Premium Income ETF (CDPI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that targets high monthly income by investing in dividend-paying US equities and through a call option overlay. CDPI was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.
